name: inference-addon-cpp-mobile-tests
description: On-device (iOS/Android) integration test addon for inference-addon-cpp

scripts.build: bare-make generate && bare-make build && bare-make install
scripts.mobile:copy-prebuilds: cp -r prebuilds/android-arm64 prebuilds/android-ia32 || echo 'skip android-ia32'; cp -r prebuilds/android-arm64 prebuilds/android-arm || echo 'skip android-arm'; cp -r prebuilds/android-arm64 prebuilds/android-x64 || echo 'skip android-x64'; cp -r prebuilds/ios-arm64 prebuilds/ios-arm64-simulator 2>/dev/null || echo 'skip ios sim'; cp -r prebuilds/ios-arm64 prebuilds/ios-x64-simulator 2>/dev/null || echo 'skip ios x64 sim'

author: Tether
